steps.note: Create the RFQ event required for the bid-rule test.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Apply an RFQ pricing template before adding products.
Add a product so the RFQ has something to bid on.
Invite the QA vendor identity needed to open the RFQ.
Publish the RFQ so it is available in the vendor portal.
Confirm the RFQ reached a real published event page before the vendor attempts to bid.

args.need: sign in to the vendor portal as Vendor A from the buyer's own company, open this live RFQ, try to submit a bid, and verify the refusal message "Cannot place bid on trade by your own company"

steps.note: The catalog cannot choose or authenticate the buyer's own-company vendor account, which is the subject of this test.
